description: A Java source file for an Android ContentProvider implementation named XmlDocumentProvider. It provides read-only access to XML data, supporting XPath-like queries to extract data into a Cursor, useful for data binding in Android apps. The class includes mechanisms for fetching XML from local resources or over HTTP, parsing with XmlPullParser, and representing data as Cursor rows, along with internal classes for cursor management.

classes.name: XmlDocumentProvider
classes.description: An Android ContentProvider that extracts data from an XML document using XPath-like syntax, supporting remote XML fetching and local resources, producing a Cursor for data access.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ContentProvider. Here, it simply returns true indicating successful creation.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles query requests to the provider; fetches and parses XML from a URI or resource, returning a Cursor with extracted data based on the selection and projection patterns.

methods.name: getUriXmlPullParser
methods.description: Creates an XmlPullParser to retrieve and parse XML content from a given URL over HTTP.

methods.name: getResourceXmlPullParser
methods.description: Creates an XmlPullParser to load and parse XML from a local application resource based on the resource URI.
